The duplicate-authoring surface now does, so this is the cue the town will actually generate: a neighbour who mentions the job, not a student who asks for a lesson. If reach holds here, diffusion has a path that does not depend on a resident inventing the request unprompted; if it does not, T5 stays 1 for a reason the hint cannot fix.
